items.caption: Seal-script-style form of 乍. This later conventional form illustrates the graph discussed in accounts of 作’s relation to 乍, but does not establish how 作 was first formed.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style strokes forming 乍 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The visible graph is identifiable as 乍 and is relevant to the proposed relationship with 作. The evidence describes 人 as added to distinguish 作 in work/action uses, while noting that this account does not establish whether 乍 was phonetic when 作 formed.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector rendering of a seal-script form, not a dated artifact image. It cannot resolve competing interpretations of 乍’s early graphic origin or establish the chronology and formation of 作.
